name: filter_nodes
author: instructors
description: Selects the nodes whose attribute matches a condition, such as all airports in one country or all courses at level 300, and registers the subgraph they form. Other tools can then run on that subgraph through result_graph_id. Returns the number of matching nodes and up to 10 examples.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to filter.

attribute.description: Node attribute to test, e.g. 'country', 'city', 'level' or 'label'.

value.description: Value to compare with. Numbers are given as text, e.g. '300'.
